title: Understanding DDPM Latent Codes Through Optimal Transport
tldr_zh: 猜想DDPM PF-ODE encoder=到N(0,I)的Monge OT映射；多元高斯证明，TT求解器合成分布代价误差~1e-15
tldr_en: Conjectures the DDPM PF-ODE encoder equals the Monge OT map to N(0,I); proven for Gaussians, transport-cost error ~1e-15 on synthetic densities via tensor-train FP solver.
key_numbers: Max relative transport-cost error over 100 random densities: 5.7e-15 (d=2), 2.2e-15 (d=3), 2.1e-15 (d=7) (Table 1)
Theorem 3.1: for mu0=N(a,Sigma), encoder map E(x)=Sigma^{-1/2}(x-a) = Monge OT map to N(0,I)
AFHQ 500 validation images per class: DDIM-code assignment cost matches POT OT cost to machine precision (Sec. 3.5)
